claim: Functional prototype with verified operations; not 100% Finder or Tahoe parity.

references.scope: Context-menu visibility, selection state and adaptive view controls; no native file mutations or animation measurements
Menu strings/actions/resources; not implementation or runtime behavior proof

path_model.development_default: demo-home or installed user-data workspace when no explicit --root is supplied
path_model.live_iso: cutefish/run-app passes --root "$HOME" when installed at /opt/makos with /etc/makos/live.json; real home files are browsed, not only demo files
path_model.current_boundary: Every Browser uses the one Bridge Workspace root; absolute paths, .. and symlinks are rejected; arbitrary volumes and directories outside that root cannot be navigated.
path_model.storage: Suite application data and local indexed Trash are rooted in the same chosen workspace; do not change that root to / to simulate whole-system Finder.
next_architecture: Separate application-data location from file-navigation locations.
Use absolute file URLs plus explicit backend/location objects per window; preserve existing default-root mapping for sidebars.
Support volume discovery and OS user permissions; handle links as links for mutations and resolve navigation separately.
Use the native Linux trash specification/GIO with per-volume trash and restoration metadata, rather than mapping system navigation to workspace/.Trash.
Add --open file-URL handling and forward requests to the existing Finder instance; only then switch inode/directory associations and hide the duplicate stock launcher.

changes: Atomic no-replace rename on macOS/Linux; broken links count as occupied destinations.
Copy into private destination-side staging, publish complete copies atomically, retain undo for successful members of a failed batch.
Persist Trash recovery metadata before moving a source; unpredictable atomic index temp files; reject swapped Trash paths and malformed index records.
Preflight all restore collisions before restoring the first selected item; deduplicate repeated selections.
Bounded recursive filename search under the current folder; skip internal data, links and special files; expose truncation to the user.
Do not open FIFOs or symlinks for thumbnails; filter them from normal listings and Recents.
Column-view Shift range selection works; Ctrl/Command toggles persist; refresh preserves valid nested columns and their selection.
Search input debounce and accurate test import failures instead of masking broken project imports as missing Qt.
Short Trash storage tokens preserve long original filenames across restart and Put Back.

matrix.limit: One configured filesystem root; no whole-system/volume browser.

matrix.feature: Create folder, rename, copy, duplicate, same-volume move
matrix.limit: macOS host execution verified; Linux syscall branch still needs Linux CI run.
Copy keeps both; move/rename/restore refuse replacement. No replace/merge dialog or cross-volume moves.
Local indexed Trash, not freedesktop/native OS trash; no redo or persistent undo history.
Links hidden/rejected; no Make Alias. Destination replacement races protected, not a comprehensive adversarial parent-directory race model.
Recursive names only; 50000 entry/5000 result bounds; no Spotlight content/metadata index; synchronous scan after debounce; inaccessible nested folders are skipped.
Internal Finder/Desktop move/copy and folder/background targets; external text/uri-list/native-app drag interop not verified.

matrix.feature: Quick Look, text/image previews, Get Info, color tags, Recents
matrix.limit: Basic metadata/text/image preview and one color tag; native extensions, richer metadata, preview plugins and multi-tag parity absent.

matrix.feature: Open With, Compress, Make Alias, Share, Quick Actions
matrix.limit: Native Finder exposes these; corresponding prototype actions remain disabled/missing.

matrix.feature: Default directory handler and single-instance open-path delivery
matrix.limit: Instance activation currently raises the app without file URLs; directory MIME association must follow functional open-path support.

matrix.feature: Network shares, mounted drives, eject, iCloud/AirDrop, permissions editor
matrix.limit: Not supplied by cosmetic sidebar entries.
No frame-by-frame comparison or animation timing measurements in this task.
Operations/search are synchronous; no worker progress or cancellation UI yet.

verification.environment: macOS host, project Qt environment; temporary filesystem fixtures and offscreen Qt input only

passed_scenarios: nested selection preserved after actual mkdir/refresh
recursive result entered through Qt key events

not_verified: Linux rename syscall execution in CI
